caseName: Twentieth Century-Fox Film Corp. v. Gerosa
caseNameFull: TWENTIETH CENTURY-FOX FILM CORP. v. GEROSA, COMPTROLLER OF NEW YORK CITY
attorneys: William W. Owens for appellant., Leo A. Larkin, Stanley Buchsbaum and Morris L. Heath for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
